Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing internet voting for service voters and overseas voters.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to internet voting for service voters and overseasvoters; and adding a new section to chapter 29A.40 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary of state is authorized to establish a method thatallows service voters and overseas voters to cast a ballot over theinternet. (2) In reviewing ways to implement this section, the secretary ofstate will consider computing hardware and software systems that: (a) Ensure the integrity and secrecy of the ballot andauthentication of the voter; (b) Meet relevant and prevailing computer security standards; (c) Use system components that are available for audit andcertification; and (d) Allow for optional phased implementation. (3) The secretary of state may seek alternative public or nonprofitfunding sources to implement this section. p. 1 SHB 1624 (4) The method established by the secretary of state for allowingservice and overseas voters to vote over the internet is exempt fromchapter 29A.12 RCW.
